admission.justification: Spans serving _task_consolidation.py projection and dashboard consolidationBlock.tsx presentation, guarded by skeleton projection tests.

applicability: Dashboard launcher/chat role discovery, serving TaskSummary.consolidation projection, and Consolidation block rendering.
conditions: TaskSummary.consolidation projects counts, memoryRead flag, and subject rows for consolidation tasks.
When memoryRead is false, consolidationBlock.tsx renders '{total} listed · outcomes not known yet' with 'listed' row badges and the amber notice instead of zeroed counts.

evidence: dashboard vitest (skeleton-bounds.test.tsx, DocumentChat.test.tsx, RoleLauncher.standalone.test.tsx, contract.test.ts), npm run codegen/lint/typecheck, and Evidence 9 pictures.

statement: Dashboard includes Consolidator in the launcher and consolidation task chats, projects TaskSummary.consolidation with counts and rows, and renders the Consolidation block showing '{total} listed · outcomes not known yet' and 'listed' row badges (with the amber notice) whenever memoryRead is false.
